scope: Complete mainspace wikitext only; literal Cite NSRW with a nonempty wstitle and unique supported wrapper fields. No explicit category is deleted.
iconContract: Nonempty wstitle renders no public-domain image; empty/missing wstitle variants that may emit one are preserved unchanged.
attributionContract: An explicit nonempty vb flag retains either the original article-level or sentence-level incorporation statement in Portuguese.
trackingContract: The wrapper is replaced with a native citation; its two imported mainspace tracking categories disappear without any generic category deletion.
countContract: One complete source-bound wrapper expansion is one atomic citation migration, independent of lexical fragments.
minorContract: No automatic minor-edit classification for changing the sister-project language target.
negativeConditions: Explicit volume, author, page, year, ref or URL overrides
Dynamic, nested, escaped, malformed or protected syntax
Title namespace, fragment, encoded or relative traversal forms
Incomplete source, non-wikitext, non-mainspace or section edit
